# TVL Data Transfer

> The sovereign data layer for AI. TVL Data Transfer moves enterprise data from any source to any target and serves it to AI agents — governed, AI-ready, and sovereign. Built by TVL Tech (Luxembourg · Romania · United States).

TVL Data Transfer captures changes from enterprise systems, refines them, and exposes governed data to AI agents through an MCP server. Data can stay in the EU or on-premise, under your own encryption keys, with auditable lineage end to end.

## What it does
- Change data capture (CDC) from SAP, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Postgres, data lakes and files — reads the change stream at commit, never scans whole tables, never rewrites your applications.
- Lands data in any target you choose: a data lake, database or warehouse (BigQuery, Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, and more).
- Refines data in three layers — Bronze (raw, as it lands), Silver (cleaned and conformed), Gold (business-ready).
- Serves the governed Gold tier to AI agents through an MCP server — curated data, not raw tables, with every answer traceable to auditable records.

## Key capabilities
- Bidirectional and multi-primary sync with deterministic conflict resolution (newer-wins, timestamp- or version-aware, or flagged for manual review).
- In-flight transform, filter, mask, enrich, split and merge; rule-based routing by table, column, row or custom logic.
- Transactional, resumable, throttled delivery. Peak sustained throughput 22,000 rows/second; scales from 2 to thousands of nodes.
- Secure over HTTPS through firewalls; runs on-premise, in the cloud, or hybrid.

## Sovereignty
- Data stays in the EU, on-premise, air-gapped, or your own cloud — your architecture, your decision.
- You hold the encryption keys, in your jurisdiction — not a vendor-owned control plane.
- Auditable lineage end to end. Aligned with the EU AI Act, GDPR and Gaia-X.

## In production
- Romstal: agentic OCR routes products to AI agents and assigns SAP codes, fed by a Google Cloud data lake. Stack: Vertex AI, LangChain / LangGraph, Cloud Run.

## Track record
- TVL Tech: 100+ projects across 6 industries and 3 countries. The CTO designed and audited the smart contracts behind the EU's EBSI; the CEO scaled eMAG Marketplace to $1B ARR and sits in the European Commission's AI Group of Practice. NATO DIANA mentor and judge.

## Engagement
- Scoped pilot, framework contract, or managed service — a working pipeline on your own data in weeks, not quarters.
